filaments.mapping: Transfer selection-aware observational discipline from cosmology to longitudinal physique/body-composition evaluation: fixed inclusion rules, explicit measurement-condition metadata, condition-matched null/noise bands, confound controls and independent corroboration.
filaments.predictionOrUtility: A preregistered condition-matched Olympus change detector should reduce false progress/regression calls and adjacent-check-in reversals relative to naive point-to-point deltas, without suppressing changes corroborated by independent observables.
filaments.falsifier: Reject if held-out reversal/contradiction rate is not meaningfully lower than naive classification, or any apparent improvement is achieved mainly by classifying nearly all observations as indeterminate.
